label: Q-26
title: NFTBonfire pot is winner-takes-all per block on a value-blind gate (hold any NFT): any holder can copy or back-run a pending burn; minPayout protects an honest burner's NFT, and the story accepts the front-runnability
severityNote: PATTERN-001 mechanical label potential-medium preserved here for the conflict rule. Assessed: Informational. Story-053 Notes call the pot 'trivially front-runnable' and supply minPayout as the remedy; minPayout reverts before the NFT burn (L101), so a front-run victim keeps the NFT and loses gas only. The only loss is to a user who passes minPayout = 0 (documented opt-out; C4 user-input mistake). Total emission does not change. Expected per-event MEV at the story-example rate is cents to a few dollars.
description: burn() pays the whole pendingPayout() to msg.sender on the gate 'holds >= 1 of any tokenId'; the payout is not tied to what the burner paid, and ordering within a block decides the winner (NFTBonfire.sol:97-112).
impact: Redistribution only: who receives a fixed, owner-set stream. At 2.5 AM/day, bots burn once pot > gas (about 0.085 AM, about 49 minutes of accrual). A minPayout = 0 loss is a user choice against a documented opt-out (NatSpec L95, story-053 L136) and is not counted as impact.
attackPath: n/a: copying or back-running a pending burn redirects the pot but cannot raise total emission
assumptions: The user supplies a sane minPayout. minPayout=0 is a documented opt-out (C4 user-input mistake).
assetImpact: None beyond redistribution of a fixed, owner-set stream between NFT holders. A front-run honest burner keeps the NFT, because the minPayout check reverts before nftMinter.burn (L101), and loses gas only.
recommendation: No contract change. phlimbo-ui story 090 (~/code/product-owner/stories/phlimbo-ui/incomplete/forge/090-forge-nft-bonfire-mock.md) exists as a mock only (FORGE_BONFIRE_MIN_PAYOUT_BPS = 9800, minPayout = pot x 98%); no story wires the live contract. The live-wiring story must keep a non-zero minPayout: always pass minPayout = pendingPayout() - tolerance, never 0.
suppressionGuard: ECON-005 (AM = phUSD dilution, not opportunity cost).
severityJustification: Story-053 explicitly accepts that the pot is 'trivially front-runnable' and supplies minPayout as the remedy (Law 2 satisfied; the code matches). The mechanical PATTERN-001 'potential-medium' label is overruled: no protocol or user asset is lost. QA, plus a UI obligation (default a non-zero minPayout) for the phlimbo-ui follow-up.
